description:
kith-core/src/lib.rs: the make_attachment(), make_mention(), make_broadcast_mention(), make_message_revision(), make_space_role(), make_space_member(), make_category(), make_channel_permission() functions all construct types via serde_json round-trip and panic with expect() if the round-trip fails.

The reason these helpers exist is that jmap-chat-types marks its structs #[non_exhaustive] without providing constructors — a legitimate design problem in that dependency. kith-core works around it with JSON round-trips.

The issue is that these functions:
1. Are pub, meaning external callers can call them and hit the panic.
2. Document the panic as 'logic error — this is a bug in kith-core' in their doc comments.
3. Accept impl Into<String> for fields like body_type and scope where invalid values (empty string, unknown MIME type) are accepted without validation.

Specifically: make_broadcast_mention() accepts any scope string, but only 'everyone', 'here', 'admins' are valid per the spec. Passing an invalid scope will not panic (the serde round-trip succeeds for any string), but will create a BroadcastMention with an invalid scope that will be rejected later by the server.

VALID_BROADCAST_SCOPES is exported but not used by make_broadcast_mention() itself — callers must independently remember to validate scope before calling.

Fix: validate scope in make_broadcast_mention() and return Result<BroadcastMention, String> instead of panicking. Apply the same to body_type in make_message_revision().
title: kith-core: make_* constructor helpers panic on logic errors without type safety
